---
title: Overview
guide-section: Get started
---

ha-automations is a set of automations for Home Assistant, called apps. You choose which apps run, and their settings, in one file: `apps.yaml`. A GitHub workflow installs them on your Home Assistant box.

## Apps

See [Apps](../docs/apps/index.qmd) for the full list.

### Lights

| App | What it does |
|---|---|
| [Sunrise Fade](../docs/apps/sunrise-fade.qmd) | Turns a light on dim before dawn. Brightens it as the sun rises. Turns it off after sunrise. |
| [Sunset Fade](../docs/apps/sunset-fade.qmd) | Brightens a light as the sun sets. Leaves it on. |
| [Light Fade](../docs/apps/light-fade.qmd) | A fade with your own levels, start times and direction. |

## What you need

- Home Assistant OS. Container and Core installs have no add-ons, so they cannot run the apps.
- The AppDaemon add-on.
- The Advanced SSH & Web Terminal add-on. The basic SSH add-on does not work.
- A GitHub account.
- A computer on your home network that stays on, with `git`, `ssh` and `rsync`. A Raspberry Pi, NAS or old laptop works.
- The devices each app controls. Each app's page lists what it needs.

## The parts

| Part | What it is | Where it lives |
|---|---|---|
| `apps.yaml` | Which apps run, and their settings | Your private config repo on GitHub |
| Deploy workflow | Copies `apps.yaml` to Home Assistant and installs the apps | Your config repo; runs on your home computer |
| AppDaemon | Runs the apps | An add-on in Home Assistant |

## Setup

1. [Install the add-ons](add-ons.qmd).
2. [Create your config repo](config-repo.qmd).
3. [Set up deploys](deploy.qmd).
4. [Add your first app](first-app.qmd).
5. [Check that it works](check.qmd).
